names.aliases.back: Latina, latina, lingua Latina, Latin, latin, lat, latine

call.speech.im_here.back: Yes, I am here and I can hear you. Go ahead.

call.speech.think_about_it.back: I need to think about that.

call.speech.wait_one_more.back: Wait a moment, I have one more question.

call.speech.no_wait.back: No-wait filler examples (e.g. one moment, let me check).

call.speech.unavailable.back: The number you dialed is currently unavailable. Please try again later.

call.speech.preview.back: 3 preview lines: greeting, parcel delivery at the door, and goodbye.

call.speech.closing.back: Farewells (7): vale, valete, bene vale, bene valete, mox colloquemur, cras colloquemur, cura ut valeas. Wrap-ups (5): iam abire debeo, nunc depono, haec hactenus, postea colloquemur, non te morabor. 3 ends + 3 not_ends examples.

notify.ap_already.back: This appointment has already been handled

notify.ap_replaced.back: The time changed during the call; the earlier "{}" is still in your calendar. Please delete it.

notify.ap_sales_voided.back: Judged a sales call, so the appointment booked during the call was canceled: {}

notify.ap_sms_busy.back: the same text is already being sent

notify.ap_sms_cannot.back: can't text this number, so call them back yourself

notify.ap_sms_no.back: Sorry, {} won't work for me after all. Could we find another time?

notify.ap_sms_off.back: won't be sent ("Text the caller" is off in Settings)

notify.ap_sms_ok.back: {} works for me. See you then!

notify.ap_sms_old_app.back: the phone app is too old to send texts

notify.ap_sms_will.back: sent when you tap Accept or Decline

notify.ap_time_unconfirmed.back: The caller never confirmed this time read back; check it with them before you answer

notify.ap_void_failed.back: "{}" from the call was canceled but couldn't be removed from your calendar. Please delete it yourself.

notify.bl_announced_hint.back: blocked number: the announcement was played, then hung up (no AI)

notify.bl_declined_hint.back: blocked number: declined while it rang (no AI)

notify.bl_declined_reply.back: declined while it rang: not picked up (no AI)

notify.cw_end_hint.back: call waiting: the phone was on another call and turned it away (no AI)

notify.cw_matter.back: came in during another call; the phone turned it away as busy{sim}

notify.f_callback_no_number.back: No number to call back: the task has no contact and the caller's number is empty.

notify.f_callback_send_failed.back: Could not send the call back

notify.f_callback_waiting.back: The call back is scheduled, but the phone's control link is offline. Make sure the phone is connected to the agent, then confirm again.

notify.f_callback_whitelist.back: The call-back number is not on the allowed list. Add it (or a prefix ending in *) in Settings, then confirm again.

notify.f_email_no_address.back: This task sends an email but has no reply address. Add the contact from the transcript, or ignore the task.

notify.f_gmail_missing.back: Gmail is not set up. Enter the Gmail address and app password in Settings, then confirm again.

notify.f_openclaw_failed.back: Could not hand the task to OpenClaw: {} (check the OpenClaw URL and token in Settings)

notify.g_bad_address.back: The Gmail address does not look right. Check it in Settings.

notify.g_bad_recipient.back: Not sent: the recipient address does not look right

notify.g_short_password.back: The Gmail app password is too short. Enter it again in Settings (it is never shown).

notify.h_ai_ended.back: the AI answered and talked; the call ended normally (the AI said goodbye and hung up, or the caller hung up first)

notify.h_ai_fail_hangup.back: the AI could not connect; the system hung up and the caller heard nothing

notify.h_ai_fail_voicemail.back: the AI failed; the call went to voicemail

notify.h_reject_hidden.back: hidden number: the refusal announcement was played, then hung up (the AI did not answer)

notify.h_reject_list.back: blocked number: the unavailable announcement was played, then hung up (the AI did not answer)

notify.h_scam_stalling_off.back: the system judged it a sales / scam call ({t}); stalling is off, so the AI answered as usual

notify.h_stall_released.back: the system first took it for a sales / scam call; a second check found an ordinary call and the AI went back to talking normally

notify.h_stall_spam.back: the system judged it a sales / scam call ({t}), so the AI deliberately kept the caller talking to waste their time

notify.h_stall_spam_nokind.back: the system judged it a sales / scam call, so the AI deliberately kept the caller talking to waste their time

notify.h_urgent_failed.back: the caller said it was urgent: the phone called the owner but did not get through, and the AI told the caller the owner would call back soon; this call was not treated as a sales or scam call to stall, so the to-do is to call them back as soon as possible

notify.h_urgent_merged.back: the caller said it was urgent: the phone called the owner, who picked up and was put through to the caller, and the AI left; this call was not treated as a sales or scam call to stall

notify.h_urgent_transfer.back: the caller said it was urgent and the owner was alerted at once; this call was not treated as a sales or scam call to stall, so the to-do is to call them back as soon as possible

notify.n_blocked_declined.back: Declined while it rang: not picked up, no AI

notify.n_blocked_done.back: Played "{}" and hung up. The AI was not used.

notify.n_fit_adjusted.back: Bageo itself adjusted the sound of calls. Now it works.

notify.n_fit_failed_title.back: Fault in the sound of calls

notify.n_fit_ok.back: The sound of calls works well.

notify.n_fit_problem.back: The sound of calls has a fault and all settings have been tried. See “First use on a new phone” in the guide.

notify.n_fit_result_title.back: Result of the test of the sound of calls

notify.n_fit_test_body.back: This phone has not yet been tested. Call it from another phone and speak with the AI for about 20 seconds. Then Bageo itself will adjust the sound of calls.

notify.n_fit_test_title.back: New phone: test the sound of calls

notify.n_fit_unsupported.back: This phone cannot send the voice of the AI into calls.

notify.n_repeat_body.back: More calls from {number} in the last minute: {count}. They were not sent one by one.

notify.n_test_body.back: This is a test notification from Bageo. If you can read it, the channel works.

notify.s_ai_fail_matter.back: The AI did not connect; the system hung up after about {} and the caller heard nothing

notify.s_ai_fail_prefix.back: [The AI did not connect; the system hung up]

notify.s_ai_failed.back: The AI did not connect and said nothing

notify.s_call_back_if_known.back: Call back if you know the number

notify.s_listen_recording.back: Listen to the recording in the web console

notify.s_no_service.back: No summary service is set up

notify.s_no_summary.back: (No summary — see the transcript in the web console.)

notify.s_no_transcript.back: The call lasted about {}; there is no usable transcript

notify.s_see_transcript.back: See the transcript in the web console

notify.s_stall_reply.back: Kept them talking for about {}; gave no data and agreed to nothing

notify.vm_call_back_unchecked.back: Wants a call back (number not checked)

notify.vm_call_back_unknown.back: Wants a call back on this number (confirmed with 1, but the number is unknown)

notify.vm_email_to.back: Wants a reply by email: {} (confirmed with 1)

notify.vm_email_unknown.back: Wants a reply by email (confirmed with 1, but the address is unknown)

notify.vm_no_choice.back: No reply method chosen (the call ended early)

notify.vm_no_transcript.back: A message of about {}; it could not be transcribed. Listen to the recording

notify.vm_task_failed.back: Voicemail (could not be transcribed; needs a look)

notify.ap_weekdays.back: Mon–Sun weekday labels: Lun., Mar., Mer., Iov., Ven., Sat., Sol.

desktop.adb_failed.back: The download failed. Check your connection and try again.

desktop.adb_need.back: Phones on USB need Android tools (about 7 MB, from Google).

desktop.err_addr.back: The address must start with http:// or https://.

desktop.err_save.back: Some settings could not be saved. Please try again.

desktop.locked.back: Enter the password to see your phones.

desktop.no_phone_hint.back: Plug in a phone and open the app. It will show up here.

desktop.pw_wrong.back: Wrong password. Please enter it again.

desktop.r_launch_failed.back: Bageo did not start. See bageo.log in its folder.

desktop.r_offline.back: Can't reach Bageo. Is it still running?

desktop.set_addr_hint.back: Leave empty to find it automatically.

desktop.set_notify_sms_old.back: Update Bageo and the SMS forwarder to get these.

desktop.set_notify_summary.back: When a call summary is ready

desktop.set_pw_hint.back: Only needed if your console has a password.

console.copy_failed.back: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.

console.err_network.back: Can't reach Bageo. Is it still running?

console.token_body.back: This console is protected by a password.

console.setup_title.back: Welcome! Three steps and your phone answers itself

console.setup_1_d.back: Add your Gemini API key and your name.

console.setup_2_d.back: Plug in the phone with the app installed by USB and wait until it shows “Ready for calls”. After that you can unplug it: it switches to Wi-Fi by itself.

console.setup_3_d.back: Choose where call summaries go, such as Telegram or Discord.

console.empty_body.back: Plug in your phone and call its number. The call shows up here with a summary and the recording.

console.d_pending.back: Writing the summary… this takes about half a minute after the call.

console.d_live.back: The call is still going. The summary and the conversation appear after it ends.

console.d_src_fallback.back: The summary service did not answer, so this is only a rough note.

console.d_src_nokey.back: No summary service is set up.

console.ap_time_unconfirmed.back: The caller never confirmed this time read back; check it with them before you answer

console.ap_working.back: Working… (up to about 90 seconds when a text is sent)

console.sms_c_old_app.back: the phone app is too old

console.sms_c_busy.back: the same text is already being sent

console.sms_c_no_permission.back: the phone app may not send texts

console.sms_c_radio_off.back: the phone's radio is off (airplane mode)

console.sms_c_generic_failure.back: the carrier did not take the text

console.sms_c_exception.back: the phone app ran into an error

console.sms_c_bad_request.back: the number or the text was not accepted

console.sms_c_sim_not_found.back: the chosen SIM card is not in the phone

console.cal_pick_title.back: Which calendar should it go in?

console.cal_pick_body.back: Your choice is remembered. Press “Change” to pick another.

console.cal_hint_office365.back: Outlook with a work or school account

console.cal_hint_apple.back: iPhone, iPad, Mac: open it and tap Add

console.cal_hint_ics.back: Any other calendar app: import the file

console.ap_res_yes_sent.back: Accepted, and the caller got a text

console.ap_res_no_sent.back: Declined, and the caller got a text

console.ap_res_sms_none.back: This number can't take texts, so call them back yourself

console.ap_res_hidden.back: Hidden number: the caller can't be told

console.ap_call_dialing.back: The AI is calling them back…

console.ap_call_no_answer.back: The AI called back; nobody answered

console.ap_call_cut.back: The AI's call-back was cut off

console.ap_call_failed.back: The AI's call-back couldn't be placed

console.ap_call_no_phone.back: No call-back: no phone is connected to place it

console.ap_call_send_failed.back: No call-back: the phone didn't get the request

console.ap_call_queued.back: The AI calls once its earlier call-back to the same number has ended

console.ap_call_answered.back: The AI's call-back got through and the caller was told

console.ap_call_not_callable.back: No call-back: this number can't be called back (abroad, toll-free, premium or a short code)

console.tr_listen_h.back: The whole call: the caller and the AI together.

console.tr_vm_h.back: Only the message the caller left.

console.end_ai_fail.back: The AI could not connect, so the call was hung up. The caller heard nothing.

console.end_voicemail.back: The AI failed and the call went to voicemail.

console.end_hidden.back: Hidden number: a refusal announcement was played and the call ended. The AI did not answer.

console.end_blocked.back: Blocked number: the “not available” announcement was played and the call ended. The AI did not answer.

console.end_spam.back: Judged a sales or scam call, so the AI kept the caller talking to waste their time.

console.end_normal.back: The AI answered and talked, and the call ended normally.

console.end_call_waiting.back: It came in during another call, and the phone turned it away as busy (no AI).

console.d_block_body.back: Calls from this number will be turned away. The AI will not answer them.

console.d_notfound.back: This call was not found. It may be older than the time recordings are kept.

console.d_scam_none.back: Not judged a sales or scam call

console.d_scam_released.back: Judged a sales or scam call at first, then let go as an ordinary call

console.d_fb_q.back: Was this right? Your answer is used for this number's next calls.

console.d_fb_done.back: Marked. This number's next calls are judged with it.

console.d_fb_done_hidden.back: Marked. A hidden number is not remembered.

console.ev_persona_stall_released.back: Let go as an ordinary call

console.f_scam_blind.back: Check every call for sales and scams

console.f_scam_blind_h.back: On: new tricks are caught too, for a little more usage. Off: only calls with common sales or scam words are checked.

console.ct_empty_body.back: Add people yourself, or import contacts from your phone, Google or Outlook. When they call you see their name, and the AI knows who it is.

console.ct_note_help.back: The AI sees this when they call, e.g. “my sister”, “landlord”, “colleague”.

console.ct_delete_body.back: Calls from these numbers will show only the number again.

console.ct_need_phone.back: Enter at least one phone number.

console.ct_exists.back: This number is already saved for {name}.

console.ct_imp_drop.back: Drop a file here, or click to choose one

console.ct_imp_formats.back: vCard, CSV, Excel, Word and text files all work. PDFs and pictures are read by Gemini, which needs your Gemini API key. Up to 10 MB.

console.ct_imp_skipped.back: {n} entries without a name or number were left out.

console.ct_imp_none.back: No contacts with a phone number were found in this file.

console.ct_imp_by_ai.back: Gemini read this file: check the names and numbers before you import.

console.err_contact_exists.back: This number is already saved for another contact.

console.err_invalid_contact.back: Enter a name and at least one phone number.

console.err_too_many_contacts.back: At most 10,000 contacts can be kept.

console.err_contacts_save_failed.back: The contacts could not be written to disk.

console.err_need_gemini_key.back: This kind of file is read by Gemini: add the Gemini API key in Settings first.

console.err_unsupported_file.back: This kind of file cannot be read. Save it as .xlsx, .csv, .vcf or PDF and try again.

console.err_file_too_large.back: The file is larger than 10 MB.

console.err_ai_failed.back: Gemini could not read the file.

console.err_too_many_rows.back: This file is too big (at most 100,000 rows). Split it, or keep only the contact columns.

console.err_import_failed.back: Reading the file stopped. Try again.

console.s_meta.back: Changes apply from the next call.

console.saved.back: Saved. Applies from the next call.

console.notify_follows_ui.back: Notifications are now in {lang} too (settings: Notification language).

console.sec_will_remove.back: Will be removed when you save.

console.g_basics_d.back: The few things the AI needs before it can answer your phone.

console.f_language_h.back: The language the AI speaks with callers.

console.f_notify_lang_h.back: The language of the notifications and summaries you read. It does not change the language the AI speaks to callers.

console.f_simlang_h.back: Only for a phone with a SIM from another country: calls to that SIM start in the language picked here. Needs phone app 1.0 or later.

console.sl_empty.back: Nothing set: every call starts in the language above.

console.f_owner_h.back: The name callers use for you. The AI uses it when it talks about you.

console.f_owner_aliases.back: Other names callers use for you

console.f_owner_aliases_h.back: An English name, a nickname and so on. One per line, up to 10. The AI knows they mean you.

console.style_assistant_d.back: Says it is your AI assistant and takes a message.

console.style_persona_d.back: Answers as if it were you, without agreeing to anything on your behalf.

console.f_key_link.back: Get a key at Google AI Studio

console.f_model_h.back: The model the AI talks with. You rarely need to change it.

console.f_voice_h.back: The preview plays three sample lines in the language chosen above.

console.f_enabled_h.back: Off: calls are picked up and ended at once. To let the phone ring as usual, use “Switch to normal phone” on the System page or in the phone app.

console.f_ring_h.back: Rings a little before answering, like a person would. 0 = at once.

console.f_normal_max_h.back: 3 to 30. Shortly before the limit the AI wraps up politely and hangs up.

console.f_prewarm.back: Get the AI ready while the phone rings

console.f_prewarm_h.back: Recommended: the AI speaks the moment it picks up. Off: callers wait 1 to 3 seconds.

console.f_unknown_h.back: On: callers without a caller ID get the AI like everyone else. Off: they hear a short “not available” announcement and the call ends.

console.f_barge_h.back: The AI stops and listens when the caller talks over it. Not every phone can do this; Bageo checks by itself.

console.f_vad.back: Let Gemini decide when the caller has finished

console.f_vad_h.back: Recommended. Off: loudness alone decides instead.

console.f_reply_lang_h.back: When the caller speaks another language, the AI switches to it.

console.f_status_h.back: A note about right now, such as where a courier should leave a parcel. The AI mentions it only when it fits the call.

console.f_status_ph.back: e.g. Deliveries: please leave the parcel at the front desk.

console.f_amb_h.back: Adds a quiet room sound behind the AI's voice, so it sounds like a real person answering.

console.g_spam_d.back: What the AI does when the caller is clearly selling something or running a scam.

console.f_stall_h.back: The AI acts interested and keeps asking for details to waste their time. It gives out nothing and agrees to nothing. Off: it declines and hangs up.

console.f_stall_max_h.back: 3 to 30. Longer calls use more of your Gemini quota.

console.f_stall_model_h.back: Empty = the same model as normal calls.

console.g_prompt_d.back: A few short answers help the AI sound like you. All optional.

console.f_prompt_ph.back: Empty: the built-in prompt is used

console.f_prompt_h.back: Filled in, it replaces the talk style and local habits. Each answer style keeps its own; write {owner} for your name.

console.p_builtin_h.back: For the saved language, answer style and name. Save first if you just changed them.

console.p_replace_body.back: The editor already has text. It will be replaced by the built-in prompt.

console.f_knowledge.back: Notes the AI may answer from

console.f_knowledge_ph.back:
e.g. Parcels: leave them at the front desk.
Opening hours: Monday to Friday, 9 to 6.

console.f_knowledge_h.back: Facts callers may ask about, one per line. The AI must not make up anything that is not written here.

console.g_blocked_d.back: Played when a call from the Blacklist or a hidden number is turned away. Manage the Blacklist in “Contacts”.

console.b_help.back: End a number with * to block every number that starts the same way, e.g. 0800* (at least 3 digits, not counting leading zeros).

console.reject_decline.back: Hang up while it rings (the call never connects)

console.reject_announce.back: Answer, play “not available”, then hang up

console.f_reject_voice_h.back: The announcement is spoken in the language chosen above.

console.g_notify_d.back: Get a message when a call comes in, and the summary when it ends.

console.f_notify_on_h.back: Off: nothing is sent to any channel.

console.n_empty.back: No channels yet. Add one to get call summaries on your phone.

console.n_ctl_h.back: Check calls, have the AI call someone and handle to-dos right from this chat. Send /help for the commands.

console.n_ctl_users_h.back: In a group, list who may give commands, or nobody can. In a private chat you can leave this empty. Your user ID: ask @userinfobot.

console.rc_desc.back: First switch on “Take commands from this chat” in a channel above.

console.rc_env.back: Take commands in the Telegram chat set by environment variables

console.rc_env_h.back: The bot and chat of TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID. TELEGRAM_CONTROL_USERS limits who may give commands.

console.rc_errands.back: AI calls per chat per hour

console.rc_errands_h.back: 0 = no AI calls from chats. At most 30.

console.rc_msgs_h.back: Past this, that chat gets no more answers for the rest of the minute.

console.mcp_desc.back: Lets AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT look up your calls and to-dos. Leave it off if you don't need it.

console.mcp_on_h.back: Works only when this is on and the token below is set. The address is the console address plus /mcp.

console.mcp_tok_h.back: Enter this token in the AI tool (as a Bearer token).

console.mcp_calls.back: May it ask the AI to place calls?

console.mcp_c_confirm.back: Yes, but ask me in a chat first

console.mcp_calls_h.back: “Ask me first” needs a chat that takes commands.

console.mcp_origins_h.back: Only for AI tools that run in a web page: one address per line, e.g. https://app.example. Otherwise leave empty.

console.hint_telegram.back: Create a bot with @BotFather and paste its token. Chat ID: @userinfobot tells you yours; for a group use the group's ID and add the bot to it. Send the bot a message once so it is allowed to write to you.

console.hint_discord.back: Notifications: fill in a Webhook URL (channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → Copy Webhook URL) or the bot's token with the channel ID; one is enough. To get them in a private message, put your own ID where the channel ID goes. Chat commands: fill in the bot's token and the channel ID, and turn on Message Content Intent for the bot.

console.hint_slack.back: Notifications: copy an Incoming Webhook URL (Mattermost too) or fill in the bot token with the channel ID; one is enough. Chat commands (Slack only): turn on Socket Mode, then fill in the bot token (xoxb-), the app-level token (xapp-) and the channel ID.

console.hint_line.back: LINE Developers console → your Messaging API channel: issue a channel access token and copy your user ID (starts with U). Add the bot as a friend first. LINE Notify was shut down in 2025; this replaces it.

console.hint_ntfy.back: Pick a topic name that is hard to guess and subscribe to it in the ntfy app. Leave the server empty for ntfy.sh. A token is only needed for protected topics.

console.hint_gotify.back: In Gotify: Apps → Create application, then copy its token. The server URL is the address of your Gotify server.

console.hint_bark.back: Open the Bark app on your iPhone and copy the device key from the sample URL. Leave the server empty to use the public one.

console.hint_pushover.back: Create an application at pushover.net to get the API token. Your user key is on the Pushover dashboard.

console.hint_wecom.back: In the WeCom group: add a group bot, then copy its webhook URL.

console.hint_dingtalk.back: Group settings → Bots → add a custom bot and copy the webhook URL. If you chose “Sign” as its security setting, paste the secret (starts with SEC).

console.hint_feishu.back: Group settings → Bots → Add bot → Custom bot, then copy the webhook URL. Do not turn on signature verification.

console.hint_serverchan.back: Copy your SendKey from the ServerChan website.

console.hint_matrix.back: Your homeserver (e.g. https://matrix.org), an access token of the sending account, and the ID of a room that account has joined (starts with !).

console.hint_gmail.back: Your Gmail address and an app password (Google Account → Security → 2-Step Verification → App passwords). Not your normal password.

console.hint_apprise.back: The notify URL of your Apprise API server, e.g. http://host:8000/notify/KEY. A tag limits which of its services get the message.

console.hint_webhook.back: Any URL that accepts a JSON POST with event, title, body and data. Handy for n8n, Home Assistant or your own scripts.

console.hint_teams.back: In Teams: the channel's … menu → Workflows → “Post to a channel when a webhook request is received”, finish the steps and copy the URL it gives you. The old Office 365 connectors are retired.

console.hint_googlechat.back: In Google Chat: open the space → Apps & integrations → Webhooks → Add webhook, then copy its URL. Needs a Google Workspace account.

console.hint_rocketchat.back: Administration → Workspace → Integrations → New → Incoming: turn it on, pick the channel and copy the webhook URL.

console.hint_zulip.back: Personal settings → Bots → Add a new bot (Incoming webhook or Generic) and enter its email and API key as email:key. Target: channel > topic (e.g. calls > phone), or one or more emails for a direct message.

console.hint_webex.back: Create a bot at developer.webex.com and copy its access token. Add the bot to a space and enter the room ID, or enter a person's email.

console.hint_nextcloud.back: Your Nextcloud address, your user name and an app password (Settings → Security) written as user:password, and the conversation token: the last part of the conversation's link.

console.hint_synology.back: In Synology Chat: Integration → Incoming Webhooks → Create, then copy the webhook URL. On your own network, the http:// address on port 5000 avoids certificate errors.

console.hint_signal.back: Needs your own signal-cli-rest-api server with a registered number. Enter the server address, the registered number in international format (+…) and the recipients: numbers or group IDs, separated by commas.

console.hint_pushbullet.back: pushbullet.com → Settings → Account → Create Access Token. Leave the target empty to push to all your devices, or enter a device ID or an email.

console.hint_pushplus.back: Log in at pushplus.plus and copy your token. A group code sends to that group; empty sends only to you.

console.hint_pushdeer.back: Open the PushDeer app, add a key and copy it. Leave the server empty to use the public one.

console.hint_wxpusher.back: Simplest: a simple push token (SPT_…) from the WxPusher website, with no target. Or your app's appToken (AT_…) with user IDs (UID_…) or topic IDs, separated by commas.

console.hint_chanify.back: In the Chanify app, create a token for this sender and copy it. Leave the server empty to use the public one.

console.hint_smtp.back: Any mail server with TLS: smtp://you@example.com@smtp.example.com:587 (STARTTLS) or smtps://…:465. The login is also the sender. Use an app password if your provider offers one.

console.hint_homeassistant.back: Your Home Assistant address, a long-lived access token (Profile → Security) and the notify service, e.g. mobile_app_pixel_9 (listed under Developer tools → Actions).

console.hint_ifttt.back: ifttt.com/maker_webhooks → Documentation shows your key. Create an applet “If Webhooks: Receive a web request” with the same event name; value1 is the title and value2 the message.
